title: Elon Musk says the cost of serving Grok Bot was "unsustainably high relative to revenue", in response to subscribers complaining about SpaceX's usage limits (Siladitya Ray/Forbes)
summary: Siladitya Ray / Forbes: Elon Musk says the cost of serving Grok Bot was “unsustainably high relative to revenue”, in response to subscribers complaining about SpaceX's usage limits — Topline — Elon Musk acknowledged on Sunday that the cost of running SpaceX's AI agent Grok Bot was “unsustainably high” …
